definitions.gloss: short story, short piece, short film
definitions.explanation: A literary work or film that is shorter than a full-length novel or feature film.

examples.japanese: {短編|たんぺん}{小説|しょうせつ}を{書|か}いている。
examples.english: I am writing a short story.

examples.japanese: この{監督|かんとく}の{短編|たんぺん}{映画|えいが}が{好|す}きだ。
examples.english: I like this director's short films.

examples.japanese: {短編|たんぺん}{集|しゅう}を{読|よ}み{終|お}えた。
examples.english: I finished reading the short story collection.

notes:
{短編|たんぺん} refers to short-form works in literature, film, or other media.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {短編|たんぺん}{小説|しょうせつ}: short story
- {短編|たんぺん}{映画|えいが}: short film
- {短編|たんぺん}{集|しゅう}: collection of short works

CONTRAST:
- {短編|たんぺん}: short piece
- {長編|ちょうへん}: long piece, full-length work
- {中編|ちゅうへん}: medium-length work

[Register: Neutral]
